newsitem.title: TURKEY: Mayor in Turkey bans turkey.
newsitem.headline: Mayor in Turkey bans turkey.

text.p: Islamist local government officials in the central Turkish town of Sincan have banned the sale of turkey and will put up signs calling for a boycott of New Year celebrations, a Turkish newspaper said on Sunday.
"Do not celebrate the New Year. New Year's day is not our day. We are not Christians. Let's not be like them," the signs will read, together with verses from the Koran, the newspaper Radikal said.
Bekir Yildiz, the Islamist mayor of Sincan, said he would block traders who attempt to sell turkey, common in many Turkish homes on new year's day.
"We cannot have them sell sacrificial sheep in the market, so for this reason, turkeys won't be sold either," Yildiz told the paper.

The local council, under the control of the Islamist Welfare party, has already banned the sale of alcohol in more than 60 restaurants and shops. It plans to fine businesses putting up new year decorations.

In recent years Turkish Islamists have called for an end to the widely celebrated New Year festivities for being a Christian festival and out of step with Turkey's 99 percent Moslem population. Islam uses a lunar calendar.
